trace.query: What programs does the College of Teacher Education offer?

retrieved_chunks.text:

SECTION: COLLEGE: College of Teacher Education (CTE)
COLLEGE: College of Teacher Education (CTE)
The College of Teacher Education at LSPU-LB offers the following degree programs:
- Bachelor of Technology and Livelihood Education - Major in Home Economics
- Bachelor of Technical-Vocational Teacher Education - Major in Food and Service Management
- Bachelor of Physical Education
- Bachelor of Secondary Education - Major in English
- Bachelor of Secondary Education - Major in Filipino
- Bachelor of Secondary Education - Major in Mathematics
- Bachelor of Secondary Education - Major in Sciences
- Bachelor of Secondary Education - Major in Social Studies
- Bachelor of Elementary Education

SOURCE: LSPU_SOURCE.txt | CHUNK: pillar3_txt_chunk_46
SECTION: PROGRAM: Bachelor of Physical Education | College: College of Teacher Education (CTE) | Degree: Bachelor of Physical Education (BPE)
PROGRAM: Bachelor of Physical Education
College: College of Teacher Education (CTE)
Degree: Bachelor of Physical Education (BPE)
Duration: 4 years

Overview: A teacher-education program covering exercise science, sports coaching and officiating, and physical fitness programming, preparing graduates to teach PE or work in sports and fitness settings.

Skills developed:
- Exercise Science Fundamentals
- Sports Coaching and Officiating
- Physical Fitness Assessment and Programming

Career and job outcomes:
- Physical Education Teacher / Sports Coach: Teaches PE in basic education or higher education, or coaches school/community sports teams, after passing the Licensure Examination for Teachers.
- Fitness Instructor/Program Coordinator: Works in gyms, sports facilities, or wellness programs designing and leading fitness programs.

Admission requirement:
- Minimum General Weighted Average (GWA): 90.0
- Note: CTE additionally requires no grade lower than 85 in English, Mathematics, and Science.

Board/licensure status:
- Board program. Graduates may take the Licensure Examination for Teachers (Secondary Level).

Regulatory basis (CHED): CMO No. 80, s.

SOURCE: LSPU_SOURCE.txt | CHUNK: pillar3_txt_chunk_58
SECTION: PROGRAM: Bachelor of Elementary Education | College: College of Teacher Education (CTE) | Degree: Bachelor of Elementary Education (BEEd)
PROGRAM: Bachelor of Elementary Education
College: College of Teacher Education (CTE)
Degree: Bachelor of Elementary Education (BEEd)
Duration: 4 years

Overview: A teacher-education program covering multi-subject elementary teaching methods and child-development-based instruction, preparing graduates to teach across subjects at the elementary level.

Skills developed:
- Multi-Subject Elementary Teaching Methods
- Child Development-Based Instruction

Career and job outcomes:
- Elementary School Teacher: Teaches multiple subjects at the elementary level after passing the Licensure Examination for Teachers.

Admission requirement:
- Minimum General Weighted Average (GWA): 90.0
- Note: CTE additionally requires no grade lower than 85 in English, Mathematics, and Science.

Board/licensure status:
- Board program. Graduates may take the Licensure Examination for Teachers (Elementary Level).

Regulatory basis (CHED): CMO No. 74, s. 2017 - Policies, Standards and Guidelines for Bachelor of Elementary Education (BEEd)
Program educational objectives (per this CMO):

SECTION: PROGRAM: Bachelor of Secondary Education - Major in Mathematics | College: College of Teacher Education (CTE) | Degree: Bachelor of Secondary Education (BSEd) | Major: Mathematics
PROGRAM: Bachelor of Secondary Education - Major in Mathematics
College: College of Teacher Education (CTE)
Degree: Bachelor of Secondary Education (BSEd)
Major: Mathematics
Duration: 4 years

Overview: A teacher-education program specializing in mathematics content and pedagogy, preparing graduates to teach mathematics in junior/senior high school.

Skills developed:
- Mathematics Teaching Methodology
- Subject-Area Teaching Pedagogy
- Curriculum Planning and Classroom Instruction

Career and job outcomes:
- High School Mathematics Teacher: Teaches mathematics in junior/senior high school after passing the Licensure Examination for Teachers.

Admission requirement:
- Minimum General Weighted Average (GWA): 90.0
- Note: CTE additionally requires no grade lower than 85 in English, Mathematics, and Science.

Board/licensure status:
- Board program. Graduates may take the Licensure Examination for Teachers (Secondary Level).

Regulatory basis (CHED): CMO No. 75, s. 2017 - Policies, Standards and Guidelines for Bachelor of Secondary Education (BSEd)
Program educational objectives (per this CMO):

SOURCE: LSPU_SOURCE.txt | CHUNK: pillar3_txt_chunk_55
SECTION: PROGRAM: Bachelor of Secondary Education - Major in Sciences | College: College of Teacher Education (CTE) | Degree: Bachelor of Secondary Education (BSEd) | Major: Sciences
Regulatory basis (CHED): CMO No. 75, s. 2017 - Policies, Standards and Guidelines for Bachelor of Secondary Education (BSEd)
Program educational objectives (per this CMO):
- Demonstrate mastery of subject-area content and pedagogy sufficient to teach that subject effectively at the junior/senior high school level.
- Design and implement curricula and assessments responsive to the diverse needs of secondary learners.

Source notes: admission cutoff from the LSPU Admission Guidelines, 1st Semester AY 2026-2027, Annex A. Overview, skills, career outcomes, objectives, and board status reflect what the program's CMO and general knowledge of the field typically cover; they are not an official LSPU curriculum document.
